# Rofik Godi Centre

> Rofik Godi Centre is a custom motorcycle, scooter, and Toto (E-Rickshaw) seat cover manufacturing workshop and local ride-essentials store in Berhampore, West Bengal, India. Customers browse products, customize foam thickness, stitch patterns, colors, and name embroidery online, then pick up their order in person at the workshop with free on-spot seat fitment.

- Custom Name Embroidered Bike Seat Covers (`/shop/products/rg-prod-09`): ₹1,099

## Workshop Services & Policies
- Fulfillment: Workshop Pickup Only at Kadbeltal, Petrol Pump More, Berhampore (no courier or home delivery); orders include complimentary on-spot workshop seat fitment and a 14-day ready pickup hold window.
- Payments: Pay Online via Razorpay (UPI, cards, netbanking, wallets) or Pay at Workshop on pickup. Approved online order refunds settle in 3–5 working banking days.
- Replacements & Guarantee: 7-day replacement on unused standard covers for stitching flaws or sizing mismatches, plus official per-product replacement guarantee for normal-use natural cracking, seam tearing, or rexine peeling (excluding accidents, blade/cat scratches, burns, and misuse).
